description: Produces a printable Court Pack for a sebbi fact (any record code, chain block number or notarised SHA-256): the fact, the sealed record, the step-by-step proof to Bitcoin, a method statement, and draft declarations for England and Wales (witness statement), US Federal Rules of Evidence 902(13)/902(14), Vermont 12 V.S.A. 1913 and an eIDAS note. Returns the link. Read-only.
name: sebbi_court_pack
title: Court Pack for a fact
